question: Which days of the dark fortnight are further specified for ritual timing?
premises: Ritual timing can be specified by lunar days.
The fourteenth and eighth days are named.
The dark new-moon day is likewise included.
inference: The fourteenth, eighth, and new-moon day of the dark fortnight are specified.
plain_english: The fourteenth, the eighth of the dark fortnight, and likewise the new-moon day are specified.
